steps.text: Talk to Larrissa outside the Lighthouse north of the Barbarian Outpost. You can get here by Fairy Ring (alp), by jumping over the bassalt rocks from the Barbarian Outpost, or from the Fremennik Province.
Use a plank on the bridge east of the Lighthouse.
Use a plank on the other side of the bridge east of the Lighthouse.
Talk to Gunnjorn in the Barbarian Agility Course south of the lighthouse.
Unlock the Lighthouse.
Enter the Lighthouse.
Go to the top of the lighthouse.
Go to the top of the lighthouse.
Use swamp tar on the lighting mechanism.
Use a tinderbox on the lighting mechanism.
Use molten glass on the lighting mechanism.
Go to the basement of the lighthouse.
Go to the basement of the lighthouse.
Go to the basement of the lighthouse.
Use an air rune on the strange wall.
Use a water rune on the strange wall.
Use an earth rune on the strange wall.
Use a fire rune on the strange wall.
Use an arrow on the strange wall.
Use a sword on the strange wall. You will lose it.
Go through the strange wall, ready for fighting.
Talk to Jossik.
Defeat the dagannoth.
Defeat the Dagannoth mother. She can only be hurt by air spells when white, water spells when blue, earth spells when brown, fire spells when red, melee when orange and ranged when green.
